items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: (To the question) The matter is said of the Atzilut of the smallness of the Nukva, namely of the aspect of the ten Sefirot of VAK. And it is known that before the Partzuf is completed in the aspect of the smallness, it cannot ascend by itself as MAN, for it has no existence in itself yet, as above in Page 738, Item 6. Therefore only ZA ascends as MAN by himself, which suffices for the building of the smallness of the Nukva. But afterward, when she has already been built in the aspect of her VAK, from the chest and below, she too can ascend as MAN to Aba and Ima, as said there in the words of the above-mentioned Rav: that in the second time, after the Partzuf already has the measure of the VAK, it can ascend by itself as MAN to its upper one, see there. (Item 99).
